title: Supervisor-bridge Windows CI repair: trace and fix the cause of the two load-sensitive real-process test failures (review-slots race under-admission; reaped-child descendants proof) without skipping tests, weakening checks or adding retries (DB-111; D-090-R093/R094)
objective: The windows-latest supervisor-bridge job (pytest tools/test_agent_supervisor_*.py) failed three times on 2026-10-03 in two timing-sensitive real-process tests while the paired run of the same head passed: tools/test_agent_supervisor_review_slots.py::RaceTests::test_global_last_slot_never_double_taken (AssertionError 1 != 2 - six racers, two global slots, only ONE admitted; jobs 111231288935 and 111247302687) and tools/test_agent_supervisor_mrl_one_shot.py::test_real_process_table_proves_a_reaped_child_gone (proven False with remaining=(8040, 8088, 8136, 8184) under windows_toolhelp32 for root_pid 8028 after a 5 s settle; job 111247110311). Under /deficit-convergence: freeze the three job logs, reproduce or reason the complete causal path from the code (the runner is windows-latest; this host is Linux), decide whether each failure is test timing or a real supervisor defect, and fix the CAUSE as one bounded change. Preserve every safety and concurrency assertion; never skip or weaken a test, never add a retry merely to obtain green CI (D-090-R094). Separate PR. Any change under tools/agent_supervisor/** voids the M0-T179 certification and takes the D-091 recertification path (a cost, not a bar).
business_reason: Owner directive D-090-R093 (2026-10-03: 'Proceed with a bounded repair of the recurring Windows supervisor failures in a separate PR. Investigate whether the cause is test timing or a real supervisor defect, and fix the cause') and D-090-R094 (preserve the safety and concurrency assertions; no skipped tests, weakened checks or retries for green).
